notes:
Lyriix Android v0.2.12

- Voice capture now waits until the assistant screen is resumed and focused, avoiding microphone startup during the transition from a headphone gesture or permission dialog.
- Speech-service errors now try the normal phone recognizer automatically. If direct recognition still fails, Lyriix opens Android's voice-input window instead of dropping straight to typing. This releases Lyriix's temporary headset route so Android can manage its own microphone connection.
- A working Android voice-input fallback is remembered for 24 hours, avoiding repeated attempts at a broken direct service on every headphone gesture. Unavailable local recognition is also bypassed temporarily. No new speech SDK, paid voice API, or continuous listening was added.
- Fixed speech-service permission errors being reported as Lyriix microphone permission denial when access is already granted. Retired recognition callbacks can no longer execute commands or stop a replacement recognizer. Cancelling Android voice input resumes the same song without retrying or running a command.
- Added Shuffle all to All tracks. It starts a random playable song, enables shuffle, and queues the full playable library even when the visible search is filtered. Unavailable songs are skipped and an empty selection leaves existing playback unchanged.
- Exact-title voice playback, custom themes, music, pairing, account data, and permanent Android update signing remain compatible. Real Pixel 10 / JBL Live 660NC voice recognition and routing still require a device check after updating.
